test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part:

She is confident __**to secure the victory**__.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of securing the victory**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**of securing the victory**" is the correct grammatical construction to express confidence about a future action.
 
• The preposition "**of**" is used to indicate confidence in achieving something.
 
• **Options 1, 2,** and **4** are incorrect because they are either grammatically incorrect or do not convey the intended meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"She is confident **of securing the victory**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "of to secure"** is incorrect because "of" and "to" cannot be used together in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "that she secures"** is incorrect because it changes the intended meaning and structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "on securing victory"** is grammatically awkward and does not convey the intended meaning.
